digest.component_or_area: store sync and push union guards
propositions: A stale clone with mismatched epoch reaching sync._union_merge must return without merging and preserve both pre-operation refs unchanged
A stale clone with mismatched epoch reaching push.py non-fast-forward retry must return immediately without merge or re-push and preserve both refs unchanged
The epoch field in .store-compat.json must be a JSON string compared for byte equality; corrupt or non-string epochs must abort with distinct messages for unreadable ref vs absent file
All nine state-matrix rows (both record/epoch axes, corrupt, and unreadable ref cases) must be covered with distinct log messages and control flow per site

Merely-behind clones with matching epochs must still converge via fast-forward and strictly-ahead clones must still return early; no placement at lock.acquire or before merge-base test must wedge convergence
After guard-aborted non-fast-forward push, fsck must report DIVERGED not PUSH_PENDING; write_compat_record must preserve existing valid string epoch and never generate new epoch values
